events.text: Before I trust a by-hand run, one provenance check is worth doing — a bit-exact claim is only as strong as the vectors it's measured against. Let me confirm our committed `real_data/hex/` set traces to the canonical CN0566 reference and that the upstream store still answers: check the CI identity, then HEAD the reference set for size and last-modified.

events.command:
echo "=== CI identity ==="; aws sts get-caller-identity
echo ""; echo "=== canonical CN0566 reference set ==="; curl -sI https://cn0566-data.aeris.internal/reference/cn0566_xband_golden.tar | head -6
